note: The last untested reference-model lever: a REAL MTP module (separate block with eh_proj/enorm/hnorm and its own loss), not the degenerate same-head variant that exp045 measured as a loss at 450 steps. Deliberately run on the lighter e16 baseline rather than on the e20 stack: single knob, and e20 is already at 92.2% HBM while MTP adds ~83M params plus an extra block's activations. Two things it must clear -- the trunk CE must not degrade (the whole point of a separate module is that it does not compete with t+1), and the throughput cost must be small enough to survive iso-compute.
